options.name: --listen
options.help: Specify the IP address to listen on (default: 127.0.0.1). You can give a list of ip addresses by separating them with a comma like: 127.2.2.2,127.3.3.3 If --listen is provided without an argument, it defaults to 0.0.0.0,:: (listens on all ipv4 and ipv6)

options.name: --port
options.help: Set the listen port.

options.name: --tls-keyfile
options.help: Path to TLS (SSL) key file. Enables TLS, makes app accessible at https://... requires --tls-certfile to function

options.name: --tls-certfile
options.help: Path to TLS (SSL) certificate file. Enables TLS, makes app accessible at https://... requires --tls-keyfile to function

options.name: --enable-cors-header
options.help: Enable CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) with optional origin or allow all with default '*'.

options.name: --max-upload-size
options.help: Set the maximum upload size in MB.

options.name: --base-directory
options.help: Set the ComfyUI base directory for models, custom_nodes, input, output, temp, and user directories.

options.name: --extra-model-paths-config
options.help: Load one or more extra_model_paths.yaml files.

options.name: --output-directory
options.help: Set the ComfyUI output directory. Overrides --base-directory.

options.name: --temp-directory
options.help: Set the ComfyUI temp directory (default is in the ComfyUI directory). Overrides --base-directory.

options.name: --input-directory
options.help: Set the ComfyUI input directory. Overrides --base-directory.

options.name: --previews-directory
options.help: Set the directory for generated asset previews. Overrides --base-directory.

options.name: --auto-launch
options.help: Automatically launch ComfyUI in the default browser.

options.name: --disable-auto-launch
options.help: Disable auto launching the browser.

options.name: --cuda-device
options.help: Set the ids of cuda devices this instance will use, as a comma-separated list (e.g. '0' or '0,1'), or 'all' to leave all currently visible devices available. All other devices will not be visible.

options.name: --default-device
options.help: Set the id of the default device, all other devices will stay visible.

options.name: --cuda-malloc
options.help: Enable cudaMallocAsync (enabled by default for torch 2.0 and up).

options.name: --disable-cuda-malloc
options.help: Disable cudaMallocAsync.

options.name: --force-fp32
options.help: Force fp32 (If this makes your GPU work better please report it).

options.name: --force-fp16
options.help: Force fp16.

options.name: --fp32-unet
options.help: Run the diffusion model in fp32.

options.name: --fp64-unet
options.help: Run the diffusion model in fp64.

options.name: --bf16-unet
options.help: Run the diffusion model in bf16.

options.name: --fp16-unet
options.help: Run the diffusion model in fp16

options.name: --fp8_e4m3fn-unet
options.help: Store unet weights in fp8_e4m3fn.

options.name: --fp8_e5m2-unet
options.help: Store unet weights in fp8_e5m2.

options.name: --fp8_e8m0fnu-unet
options.help: Store unet weights in fp8_e8m0fnu.

options.name: --fp16-vae
options.help: Run the VAE in fp16, might cause black images.

options.name: --fp32-vae
options.help: Run the VAE in full precision fp32.

options.name: --bf16-vae
options.help: Run the VAE in bf16.

options.name: --cpu-vae
options.help: Run the VAE on the CPU.

options.name: --fp8_e4m3fn-text-enc
options.help: Store text encoder weights in fp8 (e4m3fn variant).

options.name: --fp8_e5m2-text-enc
options.help: Store text encoder weights in fp8 (e5m2 variant).

options.name: --fp16-text-enc
options.help: Store text encoder weights in fp16.

options.name: --fp32-text-enc
options.help: Store text encoder weights in fp32.

options.name: --bf16-text-enc
options.help: Store text encoder weights in bf16.

options.name: --fp16-intermediates
options.help: Experimental: Use fp16 for intermediate tensors between nodes instead of fp32.

options.name: --force-channels-last
options.help: Force channels last format when inferencing the models.

options.name: --oneapi-device-selector
options.help: Sets the oneAPI device(s) this instance will use.

options.name: --supports-fp8-compute
options.help: ComfyUI will act like if the device supports fp8 compute.

options.name: --enable-triton-backend
options.help: ComfyUI will enable the use of Triton backend in comfy-kitchen. Is disabled at launch by default.

options.name: --disable-triton-backend
options.help: Force-disable the comfy-kitchen Triton backend, overriding --enable-triton-backend.

options.name: --preview-method
options.help: Default preview method for sampler nodes.

options.name: --preview-size
options.help: Sets the maximum preview size for sampler nodes.

options.name: --cache-ram
options.help: Use RAM pressure caching with the specified headroom thresholds. This is the default caching mode. The first value sets the active-cache threshold; the optional second value sets the inactive-cache/pin threshold. Defaults when no values are provided: active 10% of system RAM (min 2GB, max 10GB), inactive 100% of system RAM (max 128GB).

options.name: --cache-classic
options.help: Use the old style (aggressive) caching.

options.name: --cache-lru
options.help: Use LRU caching with a maximum of N node results cached. May use more RAM/VRAM.

options.name: --cache-none
options.help: Reduced RAM/VRAM usage at the expense of executing every node for each run.

options.name: --high-ram
options.help: Can improve performance slightly on high RAM or on systems where pagefile use is preferred over model loading.

options.name: --use-split-cross-attention
options.help: Use the split cross attention optimization. Ignored when xformers is used.

options.name: --use-quad-cross-attention
options.help: Use the sub-quadratic cross attention optimization . Ignored when xformers is used.

options.name: --use-pytorch-cross-attention
options.help: Use the new pytorch 2.0 cross attention function.

options.name: --use-sage-attention
options.help: Use sage attention.

options.name: --use-flash-attention
options.help: Use FlashAttention.

options.name: --use-ck-attention
options.help: Use Comfy Kitchen attention.

options.name: --disable-xformers
options.help: Disable xformers.

options.name: --force-upcast-attention
options.help: Force enable attention upcasting, please report if it fixes black images.

options.name: --dont-upcast-attention
options.help: Disable all upcasting of attention. Should be unnecessary except for debugging.

options.name: --enable-manager
options.help: Enable the ComfyUI-Manager feature.

options.name: --enable-agent
options.help: Enable the ComfyUI agent feature.

options.name: --disable-manager-ui
options.help: Disables only the ComfyUI-Manager UI and endpoints. Scheduled installations and similar background tasks will still operate.

options.name: --enable-manager-legacy-ui
options.help: Enables the legacy UI of ComfyUI-Manager. Implies --enable-manager.

options.name: --gpu-only
options.help: Store and run everything (text encoders/CLIP models, etc... on the GPU).

options.name: --highvram
options.help: By default models will be unloaded to CPU memory after being used. This option keeps them in GPU memory.

options.name: --lowvram
options.help: Doesn't do anything if dynamic vram is enabled. If dynamic vram isn't being used this option makes the text encoders run on the CPU.

options.name: --novram
options.help: When lowvram isn't enough.

options.name: --cpu
options.help: To use the CPU for everything (slow).

options.name: --reserve-vram
options.help: Set the amount of vram in GB you want to reserve for use by your OS/other software. By default some amount is reserved depending on your OS.

options.name: --vram-headroom
options.help: Set the amount of vram in GB for DynamicVRAM to maintain as extra headroom above default. ComfyUI will try and keep this much VRAM completely free and unused, even counting VRAM from other apps.

options.name: --disable-nvml-pressure
options.help: Use CUDA instead of NVML for DynamicVRAM memory pressure.

options.name: --async-offload
options.help: Use async weight offloading. An optional argument controls the amount of offload streams. Default is 2. Enabled by default on Nvidia.

options.name: --disable-async-offload
options.help: Disable async weight offloading.

options.name: --disable-dynamic-vram
options.help: Disable dynamic VRAM and use estimate based model loading.

options.name: --enable-dynamic-vram
options.help: Enable dynamic VRAM on systems where it's not enabled by default.

options.name: --fast-disk
options.help: Force disk-backed dynamic loading and offload over unpinned RAM. Can be faster for users with fast NVME disks.

options.name: --disable-fast-disk
options.help: Disable disk-backed dynamic loading and offload over unpinned RAM. Overrides --fast-disk.

options.name: --disable-cuda-graphs
options.help: Disable CUDA graphs.

options.name: --disable-comfy-compiler
options.help: Disable the Comfy model compiler, including its CUDA graph subfeature.

options.name: --assert-graph-breaks
options.help: Fail on Comfy model compiler graph breaks.

options.name: --force-non-blocking
options.help: Force ComfyUI to use non-blocking operations for all applicable tensors. This may improve performance on some non-Nvidia systems but can cause issues with some workflows.

options.name: --default-hashing-function
options.help: Allows you to choose the hash function to use for duplicate filename / contents comparison. Default is sha256.

options.name: --disable-smart-memory
options.help: Force ComfyUI to agressively offload to regular ram instead of keeping models in vram when it can.

options.name: --deterministic
options.help: Make pytorch use slower deterministic algorithms when it can. Note that this might not make images deterministic in all cases.

options.name: --fast
options.help: Enable some untested and potentially quality deteriorating optimizations. This is used to test new features so using it might crash your comfyui. --fast with no arguments enables everything. You can pass a list specific optimizations if you only want to enable specific ones. Current valid optimizations: fp16_accumulation fp8_matrix_mult cublas_ops autotune

options.name: --debug-hang
options.help: Enable stack trace dumps on Ctrl-C for debugging hangs.

options.name: --disable-pinned-memory
options.help: Disable pinned memory use.

options.name: --mmap-torch-files
options.help: Use mmap when loading ckpt/pt files.

options.name: --disable-mmap
options.help: Don't use mmap when loading safetensors.

options.name: --dont-print-server
options.help: Don't print server output.

options.name: --disable-product-tips
options.help: Hide console tips about new products from Comfy-Org. Same as setting the env var COMFYUI_DISABLE_PRODUCT_TIPS=1.

options.name: --quick-test-for-ci
options.help: Quick test for CI.

options.name: --windows-standalone-build
options.help: Windows standalone build: Enable convenient things that most people using the standalone windows build will probably enjoy (like auto opening the page on startup and turning on the assets system; --disable-assets turns it off).

options.name: --disable-metadata
options.help: Disable saving prompt metadata in files.

options.name: --disable-all-custom-nodes
options.help: Disable loading all custom nodes.

options.name: --whitelist-custom-nodes
options.help: Specify custom node folders to load even when --disable-all-custom-nodes is enabled.

options.name: --disabled-nodes-config
options.help: Path to a YAML file listing node IDs to disable.

options.name: --disable-partner-nodes
options.help: Disable loading partner nodes (the paid API nodes). The frontend keeps its internet access.

options.name: --offline
options.help: Prevent the frontend from communicating with the internet by setting a restrictive Content-Security-Policy header. Also disables partner nodes.

options.name: --disable-api-nodes
options.help: Deprecated alias for --offline. Use --offline, or --disable-partner-nodes to only disable partner nodes.

options.name: --multi-user
options.help: Enables per-user storage.

options.name: --verbose
options.help: Set console logging with no values or LEVEL, or add a LEVEL FILE log output. May be repeated.

options.name: --log-stdout
options.help: Send normal process output to stdout instead of stderr (default).

options.name: --front-end-version
options.help: Specifies the version of the frontend to be used. This command needs internet connectivity to query and download available frontend implementations from GitHub releases. The version string should be in the format of: [repoOwner]/[repoName]@[version] where version is one of: "latest" or a valid version number (e.g. "1.0.0")

options.name: --front-end-root
options.help: The local filesystem path to the directory where the frontend is located. Overrides --front-end-version.

options.name: --user-directory
options.help: Set the ComfyUI user directory with an absolute path. Overrides --base-directory.

options.name: --models-directory
options.help: Set the ComfyUI models directory. Overrides the models folder in --base-directory.

options.name: --enable-compress-response-body
options.help: Enable compressing response body.

options.name: --comfy-api-base
options.help: Set the base URL for the ComfyUI API. (default: https://api.comfy.org)

options.name: --database-url
options.help: Specify the database URL, e.g. for an in-memory database you can use 'sqlite:///:memory:'. Defaults to 'comfyui.db' in the effective user directory.

options.name: --enable-assets
options.help: Enable the assets system (API routes, database synchronization, and background scanning). Off by default.

options.name: --disable-assets
options.help: Disable the assets system, even when --enable-assets is also given.

options.name: --enable-asset-hashing
options.help: Compute blake3 content hashes when scanning assets. Files uploaded through the API are hashed either way. Hashing enables future asset-portability features (deduplication, cross-machine model resolution) but adds startup cost and per-output cost on large models directories. Off by default; enable to opt in. Requires the assets system (--enable-assets or --windows-standalone-build).

options.name: --feature-flag
options.help: Set a server feature flag. Use KEY=VALUE to set an explicit value, or bare KEY to set it to true. Can be specified multiple times. Boolean values (true/false) and numbers are auto-converted. Examples: --feature-flag show_signin_button=true or --feature-flag show_signin_button

options.name: --list-feature-flags
options.help: Print the registry of known CLI-settable feature flags as JSON and exit.
